displayIdentity.body: Paul recalls weakness, fear, and a crucified message. When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God. that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
displayIdentity.title: Paul recalls weakness, fear, and a crucified message
